items.title: Introducing Intelligence Age
items.content: Introducing Intelligence Age, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.
items.contentSnippet: Introducing Intelligence Age, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.

summaries.zh: 《介绍智能时代》是一篇OpenAI博客文章，探讨了变革性人工智能如何重塑权力、治理、经济和个体自由。文章主要介绍了智能时代带来的潜在影响，包括对权力结构、政府运作、经济模式和个人自由等方面的变革。

items.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
items.content: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.
items.contentSnippet: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.

summaries.zh: Stampli借助Codex和ChatGPT Work，在设计和资源有限的情况下，将原本需要数周的发布生产时间缩短至数天，成功在固定截止日期前完成项目。
summaries.en: Stampli leveraged Codex and ChatGPT Work to accelerate product launch production. Facing a tight deadline and limited design resources, the company reduced what would typically take weeks into just days. The solution enabled efficient idea-to-market transition by streamlining the development process.
